title: Derivative lower bound from a lower Lipschitz bound at a point (step 1)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, g : ℝ^n → ℝ^P, U ⊆ ℝ^n an open set, a ∈ U and m ∈ ℝ. Suppose g is differentiable at a and m|x − a| ≤ |g(x) − g(a)| for every x ∈ U. Then m|v| ≤ |Dg(a)v| for every v ∈ ℝ^n, where Dg(a) = fderiv ℝ g a.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (a : Euclid n) (m : ℝ), IsOpen U → a ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ g a → (∀ x ∈ U, m * ‖x - a‖ ≤ ‖g x - g a‖) → ∀ v : Euclid n, m * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ g a v‖
